name: Head Movement / Seek Time Computation
recognitionClueHinglish: Request queue, head position aur algorithm (FCFS/SSTF/SCAN/LOOK/C-LOOK) diya hai; total seek distance ya time poochha hai (16 me se 9).
whatShouldComeToMind: Pehle servicing order nikaalo, phir distances jodo.
Direction aur initial head position dhyaan se.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Requests aur head position note karo.
2. Algorithm ke rule se servicing order likho.
3. Consecutive |differences| jodo (SCAN me disk end ka detour bhi).
4. Time = distance x per-cylinder seek time.
variationsObserved: Do algorithms ka comparison ('additional distance' by SSTF vs FCFS).
Request ids ke saath (id, cylinder) format.
commonTraps: SCAN me end tak jaana bhool jaana.
Circular jump count karna ya na karna galat lena.

name: Algorithm Properties (SSTF direction change, throughput)
recognitionClueHinglish: Poocha hai kaunsi strategy best throughput degi, ya SSTF me direction kab badalta hai, ya FCFS ko SSTF se badalne ka asar.
whatShouldComeToMind: SSTF me head direction tab badalta hai jab ek side ki requests khatam ho jaayein.
generalSolvingApproach: 2. Chhota concrete example banao aur trace karo.
variationsObserved: Maximum request-set cardinality jahan direction ek baar hi badle.

name: Disk Access Time (RPM, sectors, transfer)
recognitionClueHinglish: RPM, sectors per track, tracks aur seek time diye hain; access ya transfer time poochha hai.
generalSolvingApproach: 3. Transfer = (sectors to read / sectors per track) x rotation time.
commonTraps: Rotational latency me poori rotation lena.

name: Matching / Definitions
recognitionClueHinglish: Match the following: scheduling algorithm aur uski property.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Har algorithm ki definition se match karo.
